message:
test(rel-0164): old-APK lane r4 -- the default standby holder path keeps its array; path arguments must be absolute

The verifier's runs oa-s / oa-p (2026-10-29 23:56) stopped INVALID after 6 s: oa_fixture.ps1 took the holder
command from an `if` EXPRESSION, which goes through the pipeline, so the one-element default array came out as
a bare string and $hc[0] was its first letter ('D' -> a relative path). The stub cases always passed
-HolderCmd with several elements and never took that path.
- oa_fixture.ps1: $hc = @(if ...). The other if/switch expressions in oa_*.ps1 and ke_*.ps1 are scalars (grep).
- oa_slot.ps1: -Apk / -BuildDir / -ServerJs / -JobRun must be absolute, else INVALID before anything starts;
  oa_fixture.ps1 refuses a relative build folder too.
- oa_orchestration_test.ps1: the default holder path (no -HolderCmd, <BuildDir>\remote60_ka_standby_holder_tool.exe
  = remote60_oa_stub_holder.exe, a new test-only stand-in EXE: no viewer, no network) and a relative -BuildDir:
  20/20; with 494d05b's oa_fixture.ps1 the default-path case FAILs with the same error (Cannot find path ...\C).
